# Agent Capability Matrix

What icx does with each agent, computed by running each adapter: a large tool result (3,000 lines), a context event, compaction and session end. "Shrinks" means the agent receives an icx stub in place of the result; "opt-in" means only with the named environment variable set for the icx hook. The verification column states how the agent's side of the contract was confirmed; agents without a live run follow their documented contract (deferred to v1.5.0, #89).

| Agent | Ingests tool output | Shrinks tool output | Injects context | Seals at compaction | Seals at session end | Verified | Pre-approval of `icx` |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Claude Code | yes | yes | yes, `additionalContext` | yes (`PreCompact`) | yes (`SessionEnd`) | live, 2.1.330 (`claude_builtin_shapes.rs`, `scripts/live-claude-replacement-check.sh`) | `mcp__icx__icx` in `permissions.allow` |
| Codex CLI | yes | no | yes, `additionalContext` | yes (`PreCompact`) | yes (`SessionEnd`) | live fixtures, 0.171.0 | `tools.icx.approval_mode = "approve"` |
| agy | yes | no | yes, `injectSteps` (visible to the user) | no event | no (`Stop`) | live fixtures, 1.5.14 (PostToolUse carries no result; `overwriteResult` ignored; `Stop` seals only on `max_steps_exceeded` or an error) | `mcp(icx/icx)` in `permissions.allow` |
| Muse Code | yes | no | yes, `additionalContext` | yes (`PreCompact`) | yes (`SessionEnd`) | live fixtures, 1.4.25 | none needed: `readOnlyHint` runs without a prompt |
| OpenCode | yes | opt-in (`ICX_OPENCODE_STUB=1`) | yes, appended to the user turn | yes (`compaction`) | yes (`session.end`) | live, v2.2.7 (Sprint 3) | not written (format unverified on the installed version) |
| Hermes | yes | opt-in (plugin `icx-terminal`; live check deferred, #89) | yes, user turn, via `select_context` (plugin `icx`) | yes (`on_pre_compress`) | no event | documented contract, stand-in tests; live deferred (#89) | MCP is optional; no rule written |
| Gemini CLI | yes | opt-in (`ICX_GEMINI_STUB=1`) | yes, `additionalContext` | yes (`PreCompress`) | yes (`SessionEnd`) | documented contract; live deferred (#89) | none: approval is per server and would include `icx_write` |
| Cursor | yes | opt-in (`ICX_CURSOR_STUB=1`) | no | yes (`preCompact`) | yes (`sessionEnd`) | session events live (2026.09.08); tool calls documented contract, live deferred (#89) | `Mcp(icx:icx)` in `permissions.allow` |

The one "yes" in the shrink column, Claude Code, is backed by a test that fails when the agent ignores the replacement (`scripts/live-claude-replacement-check.sh`, run live by hand). Of the opt-in routes, OpenCode's was checked live in Sprint 3; Hermes, Gemini CLI and Cursor follow their documented contracts until the live checks in #89. Codex, agy and Muse were checked live and ignore or refuse replacement, so icx only ingests there.
